name: Yorkville Highlands
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A California AVA in southern Mendocino County along the Sonoma County line, between Anderson Valley to the northwest and Sonoma's Alexander Valley to the southeast. It was created in 1998 and sits inside the Mendocino and North Coast AVAs.
